response_text:
1. (Currently amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube at a depth of at least 0.5 mm below the outer surface of the test tube.

2. (Currently amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube __and is not visible from the exterior surface without magnification__.

3. (Currently amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, __recessed within the plastic material__, oriented for reading downwards.

4. (Currently amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube __designed for long-term storage of biological samples at temperatures below ambient__.

5. (Currently amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __such that the polymer material surrounds at least three sides of the MTP__.

6. (Currently amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__, __with the MTP positioned between 2 mm and 5 mm from the bottom surface__.

13. (Currently amended) A system for storing samples and comprising of the assembly of claim 1, and __at least two of the following: a rack for biorepository test tubes; an automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes; and an automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes, wherein the system is configured for integrated sample tracking and retrieval__.

14. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13 adapted for low temperature operation, such that the racks/test tubes are handled at -20°C or less, __wherein the assembly of claim 1 maintains structural integrity and MTP readability at such temperatures__.

15. (Currently amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: __heating the MTP to above the melting point of the plastic and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated MTP such that the MTP becomes embedded within the plastic material__.

16. (Currently amended) A method of reading an embedded MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing an embedded MTP; __positioning the test tube with the embedded MTP in a reader device; and reading the MTP through the plastic material__.

17. (Original) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

18. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein vial receptacle and the embedded MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20°C or less.

19. (Currently amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __such that the polymer material surrounds at least three sides of the MTP__.

20. (Currently amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__, __with the MTP positioned between 2 mm and 5 mm from the bottom surface__.

21. (Currently amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, __recessed within the plastic material__, oriented for reading downwards.
